notes.title: Bundles featuring HD-2D titles plus an RPG where daily life & adventure collide!
notes.content:
VARIOUS DAYLIFE pairs up with the following games for special bundles: LIVE A LIVE, a legendary RPG reborn in HD-2D; BRAVELY DEFAULT II, the latest entry in the BRAVELY series; and OCTOPATH TRAVELER, the original HD-2D game that sold over 3 million copies worldwide!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897050/_/
■VARIOUS DAYLIFE
In the year 211 of the Imperial Era, a new continent was discovered. Explore its every last corner as a settler of Antoecia, while living your life to the fullest in the city of Erebia.

LIVE A LIVE + VARIOUS DAYLIFE Bundle
■Bundle Contents

 LIVE A LIVE (main game)
 VARIOUS DAYLIFE (main game)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014380/_/
■LIVE A LIVE
LIVE A LIVE, originally only released for the Super Famicom in Japan in 1994, is being revived on Steam! Experience this legendary RPG, brought to life in the same HD-2D visual style as OCTOPATH TRAVELER.
Meet seven heroes, each with their own unique abilities and lives to live across different time periods. Experience their stories in any order you choose, uncovering shocking developments along the way.
Purchase here

BRAVELY DEFAULT II + VARIOUS DAYLIFE Bundle
■Bundle Contents

 BRAVELY DEFAULT II (main game)
 VARIOUS DAYLIFE (main game)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1446650/_/
■BRAVELY DEFAULT II　
Seth, a young sailor, washes up on the shores of Excillant. It is there he meets Gloria, the princess of Musa, whose kingdom was destroyed when their Crystals were taken. He also encounters Elvis, a traveling scholar trying to unravel the mysteries of a particular spellbook, who is accompanied by his bodyguard, Adelle. Guided by fate, the four join forces and embark on a journey to fulfill their destinies.
Purchase here

OCTOPATH TRAVELER + VARIOUS DAYLIFE Bundle
■Bundle Contents

 OCTOPATH TRAVELER (main game)
 VARIOUS DAYLIFE (main game)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/921570/_/
■OCTOPATH TRAVELER
In the faraway land of Orsterra, eight travelers venture forth.
Step into their shoes and explore the realm as you see fit.
Eight brave souls, each with a unique talent.
Eight lands, eight stories to be told.
So tell me, friend, what path will you tread?
Set forth on a journey all your own.
Purchase here

notes.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II + VARIOUS DAYLIFE bundle now on sale!
notes.content:
OCTOPATH TRAVELER II and VARIOUS DAYLIFE: two great games from Square Enix’s Team Asano in one bundle!

■Bundle Contents
 • OCTOPATH TRAVELER II (main game)
 • VARIOUS DAYLIFE (main game)

■OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
The story takes place in Solistia, a land comprising an eastern and western continent divided by the sea. It is a bustling era, wherein large vessels navigate busy sea routes and the power of steam gives birth to new technologies. Some people thrill to glamorous stars of the stage and industry, while others are brought to tears by war, plague, and poverty. In this faraway realm, eight travelers hailing from different regions venture forth for their own reasons. Step into their shoes and explore the land as you see fit, using their unique talents to aid you along your journey. 
Embark on an adventure all your own.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971650/_II/

■VARIOUS DAYLIFE
In the year 211 of the Imperial Era, a new continent was discovered. Explore its every last corner as a settler of Antoecia, while living your life to the fullest in the city of Erebia.
